description: This file declares function prototypes and data structures related to merging in a version control system, likely Git. It contains function declarations for attempting a merge command and performing a fast-forward checkout.

methods.name: try_merge_command
methods.description: Attempts to perform a merge operation with specified strategies and options on a given repository.

methods.name: checkout_fast_forward
methods.description: Performs a fast-forward checkout from one commit to another in a repository.
